comparison_notes.finding: AgentSession.getLastAssistantText returns undefined when no usable assistant text exists (including an empty text result after trimming). rpc-mode1733–1735 wraps it as {text} without null normalization; JSON.stringify removes undefined object properties. The child-process client validator543 requires an own text field whose value is string or null. Therefore the no-text successful server envelope serializes data={} and is rejected by that client as invalid_response. The credential-gated rpc.test293–306 expects undefined, so its expectation does not establish conformance with the current strict client. This is a source-derived current-TS boundary defect, not an executed reproduction or a Rust-only gap.

Native StopReason derives lowercase serde, producing tooluse for ToolUse. AssistantMessage ordinary stop_reason serialization reaches RemoteEvent and native modes.rs output, whereas TS JSONL response validation requires toolUse. The native as_str() helper does not control this wire path. RPC-017 owns the compatibility correction; this is source-derived, not an executed roundtrip failure.

comparison_notes.topic: Native remote event pump uses content-sensitive terminal detection
comparison_notes.finding: The pump forwards a valid matching subscription event, then ends whenever its complete serialized outer line contains the quoted string session_end. An ordinary text field with that exact value can close the stream; the driver then emits Ended. RPC-036 preserves the native remote driver while specifying parsed-discriminator terminal detection. Source-only; no reproduction or external-server run.

comparison_notes.topic: Native public CBOR tag-depth guard bypass
comparison_notes.finding: The major-type-six branch recursively decodes the tagged value without increasing depth; nested tags evade max_depth even within the byte budget. This applies to direct users of the public native helper. The inspected live TCP RemoteDriver does not consume this codec, so the audit does not claim a live CBOR endpoint was exercised.
